cluster.durability_note: devnet is documented as subject to ledger resets, so this record is a receipt rather than a permanent public object

authorization_boundary.signers: keypair files outside every Git repository, 0600, devnet-only

artifact_lineage.why_the_hash_changed: Anchor compiles the declared address into the program and refuses execution elsewhere, so a retained signer requires a new declare_id! and therefore a new artifact

loader_transactions.resend_cause: transient `Blockhash not found` under public-cluster confirmation latency; no content, signature or authority failure occurred

independent_rpc_reconstruction.inputs: cluster URL, program id and vault-state address only; no file supplied by the publisher
independent_rpc_reconstruction.receipt_sha256_note: the verification receipt hash covers an observed_at_ts, so an independent reconstruction produces a different receipt hash for the same on-chain state; the checked values, not the receipt hash, are the acceptance criteria

established: the Program account was created by a public-devnet loader transaction signed by a retained program keypair, not pre-placed as a test fixture
the loader-created ProgramData account contains the exact frozen SBF bytes, independently confirmed by dumping the program from the cluster and hashing it
252 signed loader writes and DeployWithMaxDataLen executed on a public cluster and finalized without error
a signed deposit moved 1,000,000,000 base units into the PDA-authorized vault account on a public cluster
the on-chain monthly cap is exactly 4,166,666 and the stored cliff length is exactly the frozen 730-day minimum
a pre-cliff release reaches B1 and is refused with CliffActive
an independent exporter and verifier reconstruct and accept the state from public accounts alone, with no surplus and no reasons
the disclosed cost model matched actual spend to the lamport
a clean clone rebuilt in a pinned container reproduces the released artifact byte for byte, and solana-verify reports Program hash matches against the deployed program
not_established: any reproduction by an unrelated party; the method is published and needs no permission, but publishing a method is not the same as someone having run it
post-cliff release execution, which is not reachable on a public cluster under the frozen 730-day covenant; the exact-cap release remains local time-controlled evidence
period accounting across a real month boundary
a third-party attestation of the build; the container result is reproducible by anyone, but it was produced by the author and the OtterSec verified-programs registry is mainnet-only
program immutability or any production authority ceremony
purpose-bound treasury vault, IRB/oracle, LP, fee routing or multisig behaviour
production readiness, mainnet authorization or any legal issuance path
reproduce: See docs/WEEK1_B1_RUNBOOK.md, section "Reproducing a public receipt without trusting the publisher".
next_decisive_probe: Obtain an independent third-party reconstruction of this receipt, then extend to the purpose-bound treasury vault and an independent security preflight.

GitHub Actions ubuntu runner rebuild asserted in CI

verified_build.default_image_note: the default verifiable-build image fails outright; its cargo cannot parse dependencies requiring edition2024, so the --base-image pin is load-bearing rather than cosmetic
verified_build.on_chain_upload_note: declined deliberately; writing verification data on-chain is a new transaction and the disclosed transaction authorization is exercised and closed
verified_build.ottersec_registry: not applicable — remote submission to verify.osec.io is documented as mainnet-only, so no third-party registry entry can exist for a devnet program
